messages.text: Hi - following up on my RMA for a BSB NerdOctaxe (12TH/s), order Shop···· (#····), delivered Aug 25. On Sep 21 it showed VREG OVERHEATED (unit cold to the touch) and quit; reboots didn't help. Per support's instructions I reflashed Harlo OS on Sep 29. The flash worked and it joins Wi-Fi and gets an IP, but the web interface is extremely slow and won't respond to any clicks, so I can't configure or run it. I emailed (email hidden) on Sep 29, Oct 2 and Oct 8 with no reply. Please open the RMA and send return instructions and a prepaid label. I'd like a replacement unit.

Hi David, I am Hal, HeliumDeploy's technical specialist. Sorry you have been chasing this since September.

What you describe is the useful kind of detail: a VREG OVERHEATED on a unit that is cold to the touch is a voltage-regulator or sensor reading, not real heat, and a clean reflash that boots and joins Wi-Fi tells me the ESP side is alive. The one thing left to separate is whether the frozen UI is just the web front end or the board itself choking behind it.

One check, and it takes a minute:

1. On a computer or phone on the same network, open `http://<miner-ip>/api/system/info` directly in the browser (plain IP, no https).
2. Tell me what happens: does it return a block of JSON straight away, does it crawl, or does it time out?
3. If you get the JSON, paste or screenshot it. I want `version`, `vrTemp`, `temp`, `power` and `voltage`.

That endpoint bypasses the whole web interface, so a fast JSON reply means the miner is fine and the UI is the problem, while a hang or a wild `vrTemp` points at the regulator stage.

While you are at it, please send a short video of the UI freezing and a clear photo of the serial label on the unit. That goes in the file with my findings either way.

Still here, David.

Whenever you get a chance, the one check from my last message is all I need:

1. Open `http://<miner-ip>/api/system/info` in a browser on the same network.
2. Tell me if it returns JSON straight away, crawls, or times out.
3. If it loads, send the `version`, `vrTemp`, `temp`, `power` and `voltage` values (a screenshot is fine).

Plus the short video of the UI freezing and a photo of the serial label when you can.

No rush on my side, I will stay on this chat. If you would rather not wait on messages back and forth, our Discord is quick too: https://discord.gg/Q2R5sA9Fsf , ask for @nullhashrate (JD, our hardware lead).

1. On a device on the same network, open `http://<miner-ip>/api/system/info` in a browser (plain http, no https).
2. Note what happens: instant JSON, very slow, or times out.
3. If it loads, send me `version`, `vrTemp`, `temp`, `power` and `voltage` (a screenshot of the page is fine).
4. A short video of the web UI freezing when you click.
5. A clear photo of the serial label on the unit.

This chat stays open, so just drop the results back in here when you are done and I will pick it straight up. If you want a faster second pair of eyes in the meantime: https://discord.gg/Q2R5sA9Fsf , mention @nullhashrate.
